dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: My branch has a conflict with the latest changes.
dialogue.zh: 我的分支与最新修改发生了冲突。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Let's resolve it together. Which file changed on both sides?
dialogue.zh: 我们一起解决。哪一个文件双方都修改了？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The settings file. I'll use this keyboard to open both versions.
dialogue.zh: 设置文件。我用这个键盘打开两个版本。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great. Keep the new validation and your default values.
dialogue.zh: 好。保留新的校验逻辑和你设置的默认值。

communication_goal: 与同事共同解决分支合并冲突。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two coworkers at one workstation, one pointing at a monitor with two abstract converging lines and one typing. A separate complete keyboard lies in clear foreground, not covered by hands.

coverage_review.scope: W047 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W047.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：前景没有手部覆盖的完整键盘。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
